copy.title: Kwafi adireshin
copy.caption: A cikin Leafen, danna Kwafi adireshi. Wannan shi ne adireshin da {{app}} ke haɗawa da shi.

signIn.title: Shiga Leafen
signIn.caption: Idan Leafen ya ce ka shiga, saka lambar da ke cikin sunan wurin aiki a gefen gefe → Ƙara na'ura a na'urar da aka shiga.

allow.title: Ba da izinin haɗin
allow.caption: Zaɓi wuraren aiki da {{app}} zai iya amfani da su sannan ka danna Ba da izinin haɗi.

open.title: Ƙara mahaɗi na musamman
open.caption: A cikin Claude a yanar gizo ko tebur, buɗe Keɓance → Masu haɗawa, sannan + Ƙara → Ƙara mahaɗi na musamman.

address.title: Suna da adireshi
address.caption: Rubuta suna, liƙa adireshin cikin URL ɗin uwar garken MCP sannan ka danna Ci gaba.

auth.title: Yadda yake shiga
auth.caption: A ƙarƙashin Tabbatarwa, bar Shiga yanzu; a ƙarƙashin Abokin OAuth, zaɓi Yi rajista ta atomatik. Danna Ƙara.

connect.title: Haɗa
connect.caption: Leafen yana cikin jerin yanzu. Danna Haɗa kusa da shi.

done.title: An haɗa
done.caption: Claude zai iya amfani da Leafen a cikin tattaunawarka yanzu.

open.title: Ƙara sabar MCP ta musamman
open.caption: A cikin ChatGPT a yanar gizo, buɗe Plugins, danna + kuma zaɓi Ƙara sabar MCP ta musamman. Ana nuna shi idan shirinka da wurin aikinka sun ba da izini.

address.title: Suna da adireshi
address.caption: Rubuta suna, liƙa adireshin a ƙarƙashin Haɗi, zaɓi OAuth, saka alama a kan “Na fahimci kuma ina son ci gaba”, sannan danna “Ƙirƙira a matsayin plugin”.

done.caption: Shigar da plugin ɗin, sannan rubuta @ a sabuwar hira kuma zaɓi Leafen.
